categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Modifies CI configuration scripts under ci/test/ to add preprocessor definitions to test environments.
categories.rationale: Enables Boost.MultiIndex invariant checking in two existing CI test jobs. This adds automated runtime validation of container internal data structures during CI runs without significant downside.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Carries the Tests label and configures container invariant verification for test suites run in CI.
categories.rationale: Enables BOOST_MULTI_INDEX_ENABLE_INVARIANT_CHECKING to validate container invariants during test runs. While useful for catching data structure corruption bugs early, it is reasonably deferrable maintenance.
